component.name: Collapsible
component.description: Expandable content section with optional height transitions.

slots.name: root
slots.description: Container that owns the trigger and expandable content state.

slots.name: trigger
slots.description: Button users activate to toggle the content visibility.

slots.name: content
slots.description: Region that is mounted for the expanded collapsible content.

own.name: children
own.description: Content to render inside the collapsible.

own.name: class
own.description: Class applied to the component root element.

own.name: defaultOpen
own.description: Whether the collapsible is open by default (uncontrolled).

own.name: id
own.description: Unique identifier for the collapsible root element.

own.name: onOpenChange
own.description: Callback when the open state changes.

own.name: renderTrigger
own.description:
Custom trigger content or render function.
- When component has no prop, the whole component will be wrapped with `<button>`
- When component has props, uncontrolled state must be setup manually via `CollapsibleT.RenderTriggerContext`

own.name: transition
own.description: Whether to keep content mounted until its height transition completes.

aria.name: aria-labelledby
aria.description: References the element that labels the control or region.

data.name: data-slot
data.description: Identifies the rendered slot for styling hooks and selectors.

cssVariables.name: --mo-collapsible-content-height
cssVariables.description: CSS custom property exposed by this slot.

ariaAttributes.name: aria-labelledby
ariaAttributes.description: References the element that labels the control or region.
